verdict.rationale: Runpod provides compute infrastructure (Pods, Serverless, Instant Clusters), CLI, API, and MCP servers for provisioning and management, but there is no evidence of an event-driven rules/trigger system (e.g., webhooks-on-event, conditional automation, alerting-to-action) that lets users define 'if X happens, do Y' automation. Auto-pay is a fixed threshold reload, not a user-defined rule engine. missing for 10: any documented trigger/rule engine, webhook-based event automation, or conditional action framework tied to platform events.
